newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow narrrow in slow trading today on a lack of market-moving news.

Early-maturing contracts within one month were more active and rose with securities houses and brokerages borrowing heavily on the interbank market to speculate on the rising domestic A share markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen, they said.

The People's Bank of China has said that it would cut bank reserve ratios shortly and is expected to make an announcement any day now, traders said. Such a cut will be the key negative factor on the interbank market in the short term, they said.
